CommunityApplications.Profile:
**dmOffice** - a self-hosted office suite in the browser: mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes and files, with its own CalDAV, CardDAV and WebDAV server, an Android app and an encrypted database per user.
The Unraid template lives in `unraid/dmoffice.xml`, the image is built by GitHub Actions to `ghcr.io/taloan/dmoffice`. More at https://dmoffice.de (German) and in the README on GitHub. Questions and bug reports: GitHub issues or the support thread on the Unraid forum.
